requirements.duplicate_policy: No repeated URL or duplicate-consensus cluster may appear in one Featured Genus response.
requirements.provenance_policy: Every promoted media item must have a documented source and taxon linkage.
requirements.live_render_policy: A browser-render probe must confirm that the deployed page visibly matches the Calyx endpoint response before promotion.
